The two most important added values of the project are; Firstly, it helped us to get prepared for the pandemic and provided many optimization opportunities as if we had foreseen it. Secondly, has given us a competitive advantage, a leverage effect in faster inclusion of new logistics customers in our portfolio. Thank you very much to whole project team and OBASE."

Kerim Tatlıcı

g2mExper

 
"We have taken significant steps towards sustainability with Obase Replenishment."

 


 
"By partnering with Obase, we transformed our entire process by digitizing demand optimization and order management operations. As G2M, we transitioned our stocking and shipping processes—from production to suppliers, warehouses, and customers—from a manually managed system to an AI-powered, intelligent system.

Through this digital transformation project, we achieved a 30% reduction in excess stock on the supplier side and a 60% improvement in product disposal rates. For our customers, we enhanced satisfaction by increasing product availability without overstocking. As a result, we gained a more competitive structure, cost advantages, and efficiency. At the same time, we took a significant step towards sustainability by optimizing our operations."


 

 

 

 

 

 
Furkan Akiner

 
General Manager

Our Solutions

 

 

 
Sectoral Solutions

 

 

 
Supply Chain

 





 
Platform Obase

 


 

 

 


 VALUABLE DATA TRANSFORM



 

Gain Full Visibility. Forecast Demand. Optimize Inventory. 

Without knowing how your products perform on the shelf, you can't make the right planning decisions.

Today, many suppliers lack continuous and reliable access to sales and inventory data across the retail channels where their products are sold. This limited visibility directly impacts production planning, replenishment, distribution, and customer satisfaction. Building such a data-sharing infrastructure independently requires significant investment in people, technology, and ongoing maintenance.

Platform Obase eliminates these challenges by providing suppliers with real-time access to trusted retail data through a secure, cloud-based platform.

 


What You Gain with Platform Obase


🔥 Real-Time Data Sharing

♦

Instant visibility into retailer sales & stock

♦ 

Faster, joint planning & execution


⚡ Efficient, Agile Supply Chain

♦

Track stock in real time

♦

Eliminate overstock & prevent shortages


AI-Driven Smart Forecasting

🚀 
AI & Machine Learning Power

♦

Predict demand with high accuracy

♦

Minimize errors, maximize profits

♦

Make data-backed decisions fast

💡 
Advanced Reporting

♦

Real-time dashboards

♦

Early warnings & risk prevention

♦

Maximize your margins with clarity

♦

Key Benefits

Store-Level Visibility

Access reliable sales and inventory data at the store and location level with continuous updates.

Demand-Driven Planning

Improve production, procurement, and distribution planning using real-time retail demand data.

Balanced Inventory Across Channels

Increase on-shelf availability while reducing stockouts, excess inventory, and product waste.

High-Quality Standardized Data

Make better decisions with cleansed, matched, enriched, and standardized industry data.

Cloud-Based Accessibility

Adopt enterprise-grade data sharing and analytics through a scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud platform.


Unleash the Power in Your Supply Chain & Maximize Your Efficiency!

CONTACT US NOW
